data.close_reason: v0.13.0 release failed and will not be resumed. PyPI 0.13.0 and GitHub Release v0.13.0 are live and correct, but MCP Registry publish could not be completed and no viable remediation was found within the existing release.yml + documented manual fallback (see comments for full detail: PyPI immutability blocks any further release.yml redispatch; the documented mcp-publisher manual fallback is blocked by a navapbc org OAuth-App access restriction requiring admin action). Remaining acceptance criteria (MCP Registry check, PEP 740 attestation, Homebrew tap, channel-install probe, final receipts) were not reached. Operator decision: close without resuming.
